_about: SETTLE-1f §2: tags that never pull a diary entry into a rollup thread's cluster (palace rollup's pull), because many threads share them. A thread named by one of them gets no entry through its tag or its title, only through its lineage (the prior rollups' superseded and referenced entries) and continuing-thread:<name>; a candidate tag in this list is not searched. Read on every run from the --prompts directory, so edits apply without a rebuild; without the file, the copy built into palace is used. {person} and {assistant} stand for the names palace runs under (--person, --assistant). Matching is case-insensitive. Every list below is merged; the grouping is only for reading.
